subject: prd/forgejo-feature-draft
statement: Answer verbatim: “ok, your proposa is aproved.” The immediately preceding proposal retained exact-version human approval and stale/mistaken-approval protection while simplifying comprehensive privileged-bypass enforcement. The operator's original acceptance objective allows the simplest practical ordinary single-user workflow; the published proposal explained that the stronger factory guarantee requires an explicit governing-contract revision. Apply the simpler model to installed Forgejo: authenticated configured-human exact-head review and independent merged-content/ancestry verification remain mandatory for a lock; direct/force pushes, privileged merges and path exceptions are trusted repository governance. Existing GitHub approval/protection behavior is preserved. This scoped compatibility change to frozen feature-draft §3.9/DINV-1 binds only after the revised v2 draft is separately human-locked; no frozen artifact, authority tier, Source merge permission or current lock approval changes.
